  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"GLA z_proj/o_proj FP4 GEMM backend microbench (M=8192, K=4096, N=4096).\n\nProduction GLA layer chain has TWO 4096->4096 FP4 GEMMs uncovered by §2.8\ncuDNN gate (which only covers qkv 4096->12288):\n\n  - z_proj : (M=8192, K=4096, N=4096)  FP4\n  - o_proj : (M=8192, K=4096, N=4096)  FP4\n\nSame shape twice per GLA layer x 24 GLA layers = 48 invocations / chunk.\nGoal: find the best backend among cutlass / cudnn / cute-dsl / trtllm.\n\nNumerics: report max_diff vs cutlass reference. Bitwise within FP4 noise\nis acceptable; flag anything > 1e-3 ratio_diff as risk.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\n\n_cuda_ptxas = Path(\"/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas\")\nif \"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\" not in os.environ and _cuda_ptxas.exists():\n    os.environ[\"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\"] = str(_cuda_ptxas)\n\nfrom flashinfer import mm_fp4, fp4_quantize  # noqa: E402\n\nBACKENDS = [\"cutlass\", \"cudnn\", \"cute-dsl\", \"trtllm\"]\n\n\ndef build_inputs(M, K, N, seed=0):\n    gen = torch.Generator(device=\"cuda\").manual_seed(seed)\n    x_bf16 = torch.randn((M, K), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen) * 0.1\n    w_bf16 = torch.randn((N, K), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen) * 0.05\n\n    x_input_scale = (448.0 * 6.0) / x_bf16.abs().amax().to(torch.float32)\n    x_fp4, x_sf = fp4_quantize(x_bf16, x_input_scale)\n\n    w_input_scale = (448.0 * 6.0) / w_bf16.abs().amax().to(torch.float32)\n    w_fp4, w_sf = fp4_quantize(w_bf16, w_input_scale)\n\n    alpha = (1.0 / (x_input_scale * w_input_scale)).reshape((1,)).cuda()\n    return x_fp4, w_fp4.T, x_sf, w_sf.T, alpha\n\n\ndef time_us(fn, warmup=20, iters=200):\n    for _ in range(warmup):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    for i in range(iters):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    n = len(times)\n    median = times[n // 2]\n    trim = max(1, n // 20)\n    mean = sum(times[trim:n-trim]) / max(1, n - 2 * trim)\n    p10, p90 = times[n // 10], times[(9 * n) // 10]\n    return mean, median, p10, p90\n\n\ndef bench_shape(name, M, K, N):\n    print(f\"\\n=== {name}: M={M} K={K} N={N} ===\")\n    a, b, a_sf, b_sf, alpha = build_inputs(M, K, N)\n\n    ref = mm_fp4(a, b, a_sf, b_sf, alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=\"cutlass\")\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    ref_amax = ref.float().abs().amax().item()\n\n    results = {}\n    for backend in BACKENDS:\n        try:\n            out = mm_fp4(a, b, a_sf, b_sf, alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=backend)\n            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n            md = (out.float() - ref.float()).abs().max().item()\n            mean, med, p10, p90 = time_us(\n                lambda b=backend: mm_fp4(a, b_, a_sf, b_sf, alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=b),\n                warmup=20, iters=150,\n            ) if False else time_us(\n                lambda bk=backend: mm_fp4(a, b, a_sf, b_sf, alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=bk),\n                warmup=20, iters=150,\n            )\n            tflops = 2 * M * K * N / 1e9 / (mean / 1e6) / 1e3\n            ratio = md / max(1e-6, ref_amax)\n            print(f\"  {backend:<10s} mean={mean:7.1f}us med={med:7.1f} p10={p10:.0f} p90={p90:.0f} \"\n                  f\"-> {tflops:5.0f} TFLOPS  max_diff={md:.3g} ratio={ratio:.3g}\")\n            results[backend] = (mean, md)\n        except Exception as e:\n            short = str(e).splitlines()[0][:120]\n            print(f\"  {backend:<10s} FAILED: {short}\")\n            results[backend] = None\n\n    base = results.get(\"cutlass\")\n    if base is not None:\n        print(f\"  -- speedup vs cutlass mean --\")\n        for bk in BACKENDS:\n            r = results.get(bk)\n            if r is not None and bk != \"cutlass\":\n                spd = base[0] / r[0]\n                print(f\"    {bk:<10s} {spd:.3f}x\")\n    return results\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(f\"# device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}, sm={torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count} sm_count\")\n    print(f\"# torch={torch.__version__}\")\n    import flashinfer\n    print(f\"# flashinfer={flashinfer.__version__}\")\n\n    # GLA z/o full chunk\n    bench_shape(\"GLA z_proj/o_proj full-chunk\", M=8192, K=4096, N=4096)\n    # tail boundaries (in case chunked-prefill final chunk is small)\n    bench_shape(\"GLA z_proj/o_proj M=4096\", M=4096, K=4096, N=4096)\n    bench_shape(\"GLA z_proj/o_proj M=2048\", M=2048, K=4096, N=4096)\n    bench_shape(\"GLA z_proj/o_proj M=2754 (tail-ish)\", M=2754, K=4096, N=4096)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

Help on function silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant in module sgl_kernel.gemm:

silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant(input_tensor: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor)
    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale, for
    grouped gemm inputs (e.g., grouped_gemm_nt_masked for flashinfer).
    Args:
        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4, with shape (l, m, k * 2)
            l is number of groups, m is number of tokens per group, k is number of features.
        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor, with
            shape (l,).
        mask: The mask tensor, with shape (l,)
    Outputs:
        output: The quantized tensor in FP4, with shape (m, k // 2, l) but the physical
            layout is (l, m, k // 2). `// 2` is because two fp4 values are packed into
            an uint8.
        output_scales: The blockscale tensor in FP8-E4M3, with shape (32, 4, rm, 4, rk, l)
            but the physical layout is (l, rm, rk, 32, 4, 4).
    Note:
        For the shape of output_scales, `32 * 4 * rm` is a padded m to nearest multiple of 128.
        `4 * rk` is a padded `k // 16` to nearest multiple of 4. These layout constants are
        required by the NVIDIA Blackwell MMA operations.

---
Help on function scaled_fp4_quant in module sgl_kernel.gemm:

scaled_fp4_quant(input: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]
    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale.
    
    This function quantizes the last dimension of the given tensor `input`. For
    every 16 consecutive elements, a single dynamically computed scaling factor
    is shared. This scaling factor is quantized using the `input_global_scale`
    and is stored in a swizzled layout (see
    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#tcgen05-mma-scale-factor-b-layout-4x).
    
    Args:
        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4
        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: The output tensor in FP4 but every
            two values are packed into a uint8 and float8_e4m3 scaling factors
            in a sizzled layout.

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Microbench GLA post-chunk-kernel chain at production prefill chunk shape.\n\nPer GLA layer, after chunk_simple_gla, we run:\n  1. o_norm (RMSNorm on hidden=4096, eps=rms_norm_eps)         bf16\n  2. z = mm_fp4(x, Wz, ...)         FP4 input quant + GEMM     bf16 -> bf16\n  3. m = sigmoid(z) * o_norm_out                                bf16\n  4. m_fp4, m_sf = fp4_quantize(m)                              bf16 -> fp4\n  5. y = mm_fp4(m_fp4, Wo, ...)     FP4 GEMM                   fp4 -> bf16\n\n24 GLA layers per chunk -> all 24-layer time = per_layer * 24.\nWe split each step's wall to see the elementwise tail size and decide if a\nfused sigmoid_and_mul + scaled_fp4_quant kernel is worth writing.\n\nThis bench is shape-only (random data), enough to estimate elementwise wall\nsince the chain is largely memory-bound.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn as nn\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\n_cuda_ptxas = Path(\"/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas\")\nif \"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\" not in os.environ and _cuda_ptxas.exists():\n    os.environ[\"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\"] = str(_cuda_ptxas)\n\nfrom flashinfer import mm_fp4, fp4_quantize  # noqa: E402\n\nM = 8192\nH = 4096\nEPS = 1e-6\n\n\ndef make_fp4_inputs(N, K=H, seed=0):\n    \"\"\"Returns weight_fp4 (col major view) and weight_scale (col major view), alpha for a K->N FP4 GEMM.\"\"\"\n    gen = torch.Generator(device=\"cuda\").manual_seed(seed)\n    w_bf16 = torch.randn((N, K), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen) * 0.05\n    w_global_scale_inv = (448.0 * 6.0) / w_bf16.abs().amax().to(torch.float32)\n    w_fp4, w_sf = fp4_quantize(w_bf16, w_global_scale_inv)\n    return w_fp4.T, w_sf.T, w_global_scale_inv  # b mat ready for mm_fp4\n\n\ndef time_event(fn, warmup=20, iters=200):\n    for _ in range(warmup):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    for i in range(iters):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    n = len(times)\n    return {\n        \"median\": times[n // 2],\n        \"p10\": times[n // 10],\n        \"p90\": times[(9 * n) // 10],\n        \"mean_trim\": sum(times[n // 20:n - n // 20]) / max(1, n - 2 * (n // 20)),\n    }\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(f\"# device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    print(f\"# M={M} H={H}, dtype=bf16, NVFP4\")\n    torch.manual_seed(0)\n\n    # Inputs\n    o_in = torch.randn((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1   # output of chunk kernel reshape\n    x = torch.randn((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1      # hidden_states for z_proj\n    o_norm_w = torch.randn((H,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n\n    # FP4 weights\n    Wz_b, Wz_sf, Wz_alpha_inv = make_fp4_inputs(N=H, K=H, seed=1)\n    Wo_b, Wo_sf, Wo_alpha_inv = make_fp4_inputs(N=H, K=H, seed=2)\n\n    # input global scale inv\n    x_amax = x.abs().amax().float()\n    x_input_scale_inv = (448.0 * 6.0) / x_amax\n    Wz_alpha = (1.0 / (x_input_scale_inv * Wz_alpha_inv)).reshape((1,)).cuda()\n\n    # m global scale inv (after sigmoid+mul, similar magnitude to o_in)\n    m_amax = (o_in * torch.sigmoid(torch.randn_like(o_in))).abs().amax().float()\n    m_input_scale_inv = (448.0 * 6.0) / m_amax\n    Wo_alpha = (1.0 / (m_input_scale_inv * Wo_alpha_inv)).reshape((1,)).cuda()\n\n    # Buffers we re-use across iters\n    z_buf = torch.empty((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    sig_buf = torch.empty((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    mul_buf = torch.empty((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    o_norm_buf = torch.empty((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    out_buf = torch.empty((M, H), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n\n    # === step times ===\n    rms = nn.RMSNorm(H, eps=EPS).to(device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    rms.weight.data = o_norm_w.clone()\n\n    def step_o_norm():\n        return rms(o_in)\n\n    def step_zproj_full():\n        x_fp4, x_sf = fp4_quantize(x, x_input_scale_inv)\n        return mm_fp4(x_fp4, Wz_b, x_sf, Wz_sf, Wz_alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=\"cutlass\")\n\n    def step_zproj_input_quant_only():\n        return fp4_quantize(x, x_input_scale_inv)\n\n    z_const = step_zproj_full().contiguous()\n\n    def step_sigmoid():\n        return torch.sigmoid(z_const)\n\n    on_const = step_o_norm().contiguous()\n    sig_const = torch.sigmoid(z_const).contiguous()\n\n    def step_mul():\n        return on_const * sig_const\n\n    def step_sigmoid_mul_combined():\n        # what production currently does: o = o_norm_out * sigmoid(z)\n        return on_const * torch.sigmoid(z_const)\n\n    m_const = (on_const * sig_const).contiguous()\n\n    def step_input_quant_o():\n        return fp4_quantize(m_const, m_input_scale_inv)\n\n    m_fp4_buf, m_sf_buf = step_input_quant_o()\n\n    def step_oproj_gemm_only():\n        return mm_fp4(m_fp4_buf, Wo_b, m_sf_buf, Wo_sf, Wo_alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=\"cutlass\")\n\n    def step_oproj_full():\n        m_fp4, m_sf = fp4_quantize(m_const, m_input_scale_inv)\n        return mm_fp4(m_fp4, Wo_b, m_sf, Wo_sf, Wo_alpha, torch.bfloat16, backend=\"cutlass\")\n\n    # Run timings\n    items = [\n        (\"o_norm (RMSNorm bf16)\",            step_o_norm),\n        (\"z_proj fp4_quantize input only\",   step_zproj_input_quant_only),\n        (\"z_proj full (fp4_quant + GEMM)\",   step_zproj_full),\n        (\"sigmoid\",                          step_sigmoid),\n        (\"mul (a*b)\",                        step_mul),\n        (\"sigmoid + mul (combined call)\",    step_sigmoid_mul_combined),\n        (\"input_fp4_quant on m\",             step_input_quant_o),\n        (\"o_proj GEMM only\",                 step_oproj_gemm_only),\n        (\"o_proj full (fp4_quant + GEMM)\",   step_oproj_full),\n    ]\n    print(f\"\\n{'step':<40s} {'p10':>8s} {'med':>8s} {'mean_t':>8s} {'p90':>8s}   (us)\")\n    rows = []\n    for name, fn in items:\n        # warm + run + sync\n        torch.cuda.synchronize()\n        t = time_event(fn, warmup=20, iters=200)\n        rows.append((name, t))\n        print(f\"  {name:<40s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean_trim']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    # Synthesis: total per-layer chain wall (using p10 since memory-bound is stable)\n    def get(name):\n        for n, t in rows:\n            if n == name:\n                return t[\"p10\"]\n        return None\n\n    o_n = get(\"o_norm (RMSNorm bf16)\")\n    z_full = get(\"z_proj full (fp4_quant + GEMM)\")\n    sig = get(\"sigmoid\")\n    mul = get(\"mul (a*b)\")\n    sm_comb = get(\"sigmoid + mul (combined call)\")\n    iqm = get(\"input_fp4_quant on m\")\n    o_full = get(\"o_proj full (fp4_quant + GEMM)\")\n    o_gemm = get(\"o_proj GEMM only\")\n\n    print(f\"\\n[synthesis] (p10, us)\")\n    chain_separated = o_n + z_full + sig + mul + iqm + o_gemm\n    chain_combined  = o_n + z_full + sm_comb     + iqm + o_gemm\n    print(f\"  o_norm+z_proj+sigmoid+mul+input_fp4q+o_proj_gemm = {chain_separated:.1f}us / layer\")\n    print(f\"  current production chain (sigmoid_mul as one)    = {chain_combined:.1f}us / layer\")\n    print(f\"  x24 layers/chunk total                          = {chain_combined*24/1000:.2f} ms\")\n    print()\n    print(f\"  >>> hypothetical fused 'sigmoid_mul_scaled_fp4_quant' replaces:\")\n    print(f\"      sigmoid({sig:.0f}) + mul({mul:.0f}) + input_fp4q({iqm:.0f}) -> roughly read(o,z)+write(fp4) ~= 2/3 of (sigmoid+mul) + iqm.\")\n    print(f\"      conservative estimate (one read each o_norm_out and z, one fp4 write+scale write):\")\n    bytes_read = 2 * M * H * 2  # bf16 o_norm_out + bf16 z = 2 reads * 32MB\n    bytes_write = M * H // 2 + (M // 128) * (H // 16) * 1  # fp4 + scale\n    bw_estimate_us = (bytes_read + bytes_write) / (1.0e12) * 1e6  # 1 TB/s HBM rough\n    fused_estimate = bw_estimate_us\n    print(f\"      ~{fused_estimate:.0f}us (BW-bound, 1TB/s)  vs current sig+mul+iqm = {sig+mul+iqm:.0f}us  -> save ~{(sig+mul+iqm)-fused_estimate:.0f}us/layer = {((sig+mul+iqm)-fused_estimate)*24/1000:.2f}ms/chunk\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/kernels/minicpm/bench_gla_qk_norm.py",
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Microbench RMSNorm at GLA q_norm/k_norm shape: N=8192*32=262144, D=128, bf16.\n\nProduction: per-layer there are TWO RMSNorm calls (q_norm + k_norm) on this\nshape. 24 GLA layers -> 48 launches/chunk. Online profile reports\ngla_qk_norm_ms ~20ms/chunk (8192 tokens), so each pair averages ~0.85ms,\neach single call ~0.42ms. BW-bound estimate is ~128us so there is launch /\nconfig overhead worth investigating.\n\nCompare:\n  1. sgl_kernel.rmsnorm (production)\n  2. torch native (reference for max_diff)\n  3. hand-written triton kernel - shape-specialized for D=128 fp32 reduce\n  4. fused q+k norm into one launch (per-row 256-d split into two halves)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\n\n_cuda_ptxas = Path(\"/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas\")\nif \"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\" not in os.environ and _cuda_ptxas.exists():\n    os.environ[\"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\"] = str(_cuda_ptxas)\n\nimport triton\nimport triton.language as tl\nfrom sgl_kernel import rmsnorm as sgl_rmsnorm\n\n# Production GLA dims\nT = 8192   # tokens / chunk\nNH = 32    # both nh and nkv = 32 in MiniCPM-SALA\nD = 128\nEPS = 1e-6\n\n\ndef time_us(fn, warmup=20, iters=300):\n    for _ in range(warmup):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    for i in range(iters):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    n = len(times)\n    return {\n        \"p10\": times[n // 10],\n        \"median\": times[n // 2],\n        \"p90\": times[(9 * n) // 10],\n        \"mean\": sum(times[n//20:n-n//20]) / max(1, n - 2*(n//20)),\n    }\n\n\ndef torch_rmsnorm(x, w, eps):\n    x_f = x.float()\n    rstd = (x_f.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps).rsqrt()\n    return (x_f * rstd).to(x.dtype) * w\n\n\n@triton.jit\ndef _rmsnorm_d128_kernel(\n    X, W, Y,\n    stride_xn, stride_yn,\n    eps,\n    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,  # = 128 (full row)\n):\n    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)\n    x = tl.load(X + pid * stride_xn + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    w = tl.load(W + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / BLOCK\n    rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)\n    y = (x * rstd) * w\n    tl.store(Y + pid * stride_yn + cols, y.to(Y.dtype.element_ty))\n\n\ndef my_rmsnorm_d128(x, w, eps):\n    N = x.shape[0]\n    y = torch.empty_like(x)\n    _rmsnorm_d128_kernel[(N,)](\n        x, w, y,\n        x.stride(0), y.stride(0),\n        eps, BLOCK=128,\n        num_warps=4, num_stages=1,\n    )\n    return y\n\n\n@triton.jit\ndef _rmsnorm_d128_qk_kernel(\n    XQ, XK, WQ, WK, YQ, YK,\n    stride_n,\n    eps,\n    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,  # 128\n):\n    \"\"\"Fused: do one row of q_norm and one row of k_norm in the same program.\n\n    Grid: (N,). Each program loads q[i,:], k[i,:], q_w, k_w from gmem; writes both back.\n    Saves launch overhead (1 kernel vs 2).\n    \"\"\"\n    pid = tl.program_id(0)\n    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)\n    xq = tl.load(XQ + pid * stride_n + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    xk = tl.load(XK + pid * stride_n + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    wq = tl.load(WQ + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    wk = tl.load(WK + cols).to(tl.float32)\n    rq = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(xq * xq, axis=0) / BLOCK + eps)\n    rk = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(xk * xk, axis=0) / BLOCK + eps)\n    yq = (xq * rq) * wq\n    yk = (xk * rk) * wk\n    tl.store(YQ + pid * stride_n + cols, yq.to(YQ.dtype.element_ty))\n    tl.store(YK + pid * stride_n + cols, yk.to(YK.dtype.element_ty))\n\n\ndef my_rmsnorm_qk_fused(xq, xk, wq, wk, eps):\n    N = xq.shape[0]\n    yq = torch.empty_like(xq)\n    yk = torch.empty_like(xk)\n    _rmsnorm_d128_qk_kernel[(N,)](\n        xq, xk, wq, wk, yq, yk,\n        xq.stride(0),\n        eps, BLOCK=128,\n        num_warps=4, num_stages=1,\n    )\n    return yq, yk\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(f\"# device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    N = T * NH\n    print(f\"# shape: ({N}, {D}) bf16, eps={EPS}\")\n    torch.manual_seed(0)\n    x = torch.randn((N, D), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n    w = torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3\n    xk = torch.randn((N, D), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5\n    wk = torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3\n\n    # === correctness ===\n    y_ref = torch_rmsnorm(x, w, EPS)\n    y_sgl = sgl_rmsnorm(x, w, EPS)\n    y_mine = my_rmsnorm_d128(x, w, EPS)\n\n    diff_sgl = (y_ref.float() - y_sgl.float()).abs().max().item()\n    diff_mine = (y_ref.float() - y_mine.float()).abs().max().item()\n    diff_sgl_mine = (y_sgl.float() - y_mine.float()).abs().max().item()\n    print(f\"  numeric: ref vs sgl     max_diff={diff_sgl:.3g}\")\n    print(f\"  numeric: ref vs mine    max_diff={diff_mine:.3g}\")\n    print(f\"  numeric: sgl vs mine    max_diff={diff_sgl_mine:.3g}\")\n\n    yq_f, yk_f = my_rmsnorm_qk_fused(x, xk, w, wk, EPS)\n    yq_ref = sgl_rmsnorm(x, w, EPS)\n    yk_ref = sgl_rmsnorm(xk, wk, EPS)\n    print(f\"  numeric: qk_fused vs sgl(q) max_diff={(yq_f.float()-yq_ref.float()).abs().max().item():.3g}\")\n    print(f\"  numeric: qk_fused vs sgl(k) max_diff={(yk_f.float()-yk_ref.float()).abs().max().item():.3g}\")\n\n    # === timing ===\n    print(f\"\\n{'kernel':<35s} {'p10':>8s} {'med':>8s} {'mean':>8s} {'p90':>8s}   (us)\")\n\n    t = time_us(lambda: sgl_rmsnorm(x, w, EPS))\n    print(f\"  {'sgl_kernel.rmsnorm (single)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    t = time_us(lambda: my_rmsnorm_d128(x, w, EPS))\n    print(f\"  {'triton mine (single, BLOCK=128)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    def two_sgl():\n        sgl_rmsnorm(x, w, EPS)\n        sgl_rmsnorm(xk, wk, EPS)\n    t = time_us(two_sgl)\n    print(f\"  {'2x sgl_kernel.rmsnorm (q,k)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    t = time_us(lambda: my_rmsnorm_qk_fused(x, xk, w, wk, EPS))\n    print(f\"  {'triton fused qk_rmsnorm':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    # extrapolate\n    print(f\"\\n[extrapolation] 24 GLA layers/chunk:\")\n    base_pair = time_us(two_sgl)['p10']\n    fused_pair = time_us(lambda: my_rmsnorm_qk_fused(x, xk, w, wk, EPS))['p10']\n    print(f\"  current (2x sgl per layer)   x24 = {base_pair*24/1000:.2f}ms / chunk\")\n    print(f\"  fused triton (1x per layer)  x24 = {fused_pair*24/1000:.2f}ms / chunk\")\n    print(f\"  potential save               = {(base_pair-fused_pair)*24/1000:.2f}ms / chunk\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

但 sgl vs mine max_diff=0.00781 不追求bitwise 这个误差你认为是否可接受？

> AGENT

**判断**：理论上是 1 bf16 ulp（在 ~1.0 量级 ulp = 2^-7 ≈ 0.00781），是 fp32 reduce 重排能达到的最小可见差异，不可避免。但单独看小 ≠ 端到端可接受。

风险点：
1. q/k 各层差 1 ulp → 经 `chunk_simple_gla` (Q·K^T → softmax → ·V) 通常放大 2-3 ulp → o_proj → 残差 → 跨 32 层累积可能到 ~5-8 ulp（量级仍很小但确实存在）
2. **关键传播路径**：GLA 输出最终影响后续 standard attn layer 的 hidden_states，进而影响 stage1 score 和 sparse topk 决策。文档 §2.11 / §3.14 都有"1 ulp 级输入差异 → topk 大面积变化"的前科（如 §3.14 stage1 输入转 fp16 `bad 1500035/1572864`，TileLang `bad_sorted=19315/24576`）
3. 所以**不能默认可接受**。

我建议路径：
- 先把 fused triton 接进 GLA，**只做线上对比**（stage1 topk match 率 + std attn hidden_states max_diff），不动 baseline
- 如果 topk@128 match 率 ≥99.9% 且 hidden 误差不发散 → 收 8.85ms（约 1.2% wall）
- 否则走 bitwise 路径：去 sgl_kernel 找 D=128 specialize 优化机会，或写一个跟它 reduce ordering 一致的 fused kernel

你觉得先按这个走 A/B 一致性验证吗？

63	__inline__ __device__ T warpReduceSum(T val) {
64	#pragma unroll
65	  for (int mask = 16; mask > 0; mask >>= 1)
66	    val += __shfl_xor_sync(FINAL_MASK, val, mask,
67	                           32);  //__shfl_sync bf16 return float when sm < 80
68	  return val;
69	}

79	__device__ inline float compute_freq_yarn(float base, int head_dim, int half_dim, float factor, float low, float high) {
80	  float freq = powf(base, -2.0f * half_dim / static_cast<float>(head_dim));
81	
82	  if (factor != 1.0f) {
83	    float inv_freq_extrapolation = freq;
84	    float inv_freq_interpolation = freq / factor;
85	
86	    float high_adj = high;
87	    if (fabsf(low - high_adj) <= 1e-6f) {
88	      high_adj += 0.001f;
89	    }
90	
91	    float linear_func = (static_cast<float>(half_dim) - low) / (high_adj - low);
92	    float ramp_func = fminf(fmaxf(linear_func, 0.0f), 1.0f);
93	    float inv_freq_extrapolation_factor = 1.0f - ramp_func;
94	
95	    freq = inv_freq_interpolation * (1.0f - inv_freq_extrapolation_factor) +
96	           inv_freq_extrapolation * inv_freq_extrapolation_factor;
97	  }
98	
99	  return freq;
100	}

104	// Perform per-head QK Norm and RoPE in a single kernel.
105	// head_dim: the dimension of each head
106	// interleave: interleave=!is_neox.
107	template <int head_dim, bool interleave>
108	__global__ void fusedQKNormRopeKernel(
109	    __nv_bfloat16* qkv,             // Combined QKV tensor [num_tokens, (num_heads_q+num_heads_k+num_heads_v)*head_dim]
110	    int const num_heads_q,          // Number of query heads
111	    int const num_heads_k,          // Number of key heads
112	    int const num_heads_v,          // Number of value heads
113	    float const eps,                // Epsilon for RMS normalization
114	    __nv_bfloat16 const* q_weight,  // RMSNorm weights for query
115	    __nv_bfloat16 const* k_weight,  // RMSNorm weights for key
116	    float const base,               // Base for RoPE computation
117	    int const* position_ids,        // Position IDs for RoPE
118	    int const num_tokens,           // Number of tokens
119	    // parameters for yarn
120	    float factor,  // factor in rope_scaling in config.json. When it is not 1.0, it means the model is using yarn.
121	    float low,     // threshold for high frequency
122	    float high,    // threshold for low frequency
123	    float attention_factor,  // attention_factor applied on cos and sin
124	    int const rotary_dim) {
125	  int const warpsPerBlock = blockDim.x / 32;
126	  int const warpId = threadIdx.x / 32;
127	  int const laneId = threadIdx.x % 32;
128	
129	  // Calculate global warp index to determine which head/token this warp processes
130	  int const globalWarpIdx = blockIdx.x * warpsPerBlock + warpId;
131	
132	  // Total number of attention heads (Q and K)
133	  int const total_qk_heads = num_heads_q + num_heads_k;
134	
135	  // Determine which token and head type (Q or K) this warp processes
136	  int const tokenIdx = globalWarpIdx / total_qk_heads;
137	  int const localHeadIdx = globalWarpIdx % total_qk_heads;
138	
139	  // Skip if this warp is assigned beyond the number of tokens
140	  if (tokenIdx >= num_tokens) return;
141	
142	  bool const isQ = localHeadIdx < num_heads_q;
143	  int const headIdx = isQ ? localHeadIdx : localHeadIdx - num_heads_q;
144	  int const num_heads = num_heads_q + num_heads_k + num_heads_v;
145	  static_assert(
146	      head_dim % (32 * 2) == 0,
147	      "head_dim must be divisible by 64 (each warp processes one head, and each thread gets even number of "
148	      "elements)");
149	  constexpr int numElemsPerThread = head_dim / 32;
150	  float elements[numElemsPerThread];
151	  constexpr int elemSizeBytes = numElemsPerThread * sizeof(__nv_bfloat16);
152	  static_assert(elemSizeBytes % 4 == 0, "numSizeBytes must be a multiple of 4");
153	  constexpr int vecSize = elemSizeBytes / 4;  // Use packed_as<uint, vecSize> to perform loading/saving.
154	  using vec_T = typename tensorrt_llm::common::packed_as<uint, vecSize>::type;
155	
156	  int offsetWarp;  // Offset for the warp
157	  if (isQ) {
158	    // Q segment: token offset + head offset within Q segment
159	    offsetWarp = tokenIdx * num_heads * head_dim + headIdx * head_dim;
160	  } else {
161	    // K segment: token offset + entire Q segment + head offset within K segment
162	    offsetWarp = tokenIdx * num_heads * head_dim + num_heads_q * head_dim + headIdx * head_dim;
163	  }
164	  int offsetThread = offsetWarp + laneId * numElemsPerThread;
165	
166	  // Sum of squares for RMSNorm
167	  float sumOfSquares = 0.0f;
168	
169	  // Load.
170	  {
171	    vec_T vec = *reinterpret_cast<vec_T const*>(&qkv[offsetThread]);
172	    for (int i = 0; i < vecSize; i++) {
173	      float2 vals = __bfloat1622float2(*reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat162*>(reinterpret_cast<uint*>(&vec) + i));
174	      sumOfSquares += vals.x * vals.x;
175	      sumOfSquares += vals.y * vals.y;
176	      elements[2 * i] = vals.x;
177	      elements[2 * i + 1] = vals.y;
178	    }
179	  }
180	
181	  // Reduce sum across warp using the utility function
182	  sumOfSquares = tensorrt_llm::common::warpReduceSum(sumOfSquares);
183	
184	  // Compute RMS normalization factor
185	  float rms_rcp = rsqrtf(sumOfSquares / static_cast<float>(head_dim) + eps);
186	
187	  // Normalize elements
188	  for (int i = 0; i < numElemsPerThread; i++) {
189	    int dim = laneId * numElemsPerThread + i;
190	    float weight = isQ ? __bfloat162float(q_weight[dim]) : __bfloat162float(k_weight[dim]);
191	    elements[i] *= rms_rcp * weight;
192	  }
193	  // Apply RoPE to normalized elements
194	  float elements2[numElemsPerThread];  // Additional buffer required for RoPE.
195	  float cos_vals[numElemsPerThread];
196	  float sin_vals[numElemsPerThread];
197	  float pos_id = static_cast<float>(position_ids[tokenIdx]);
198	  int const rotary_lanes = rotary_dim / numElemsPerThread;  // rotary range
199	  bool const applyRotary = (laneId < rotary_lanes);
200	  if (applyRotary) {
201	    if constexpr (interleave) {
202	      // Perform interleaving. Fill cos_vals and sin_vals.
203	      for (int i = 0; i < numElemsPerThread; i++) {
204	        elements2[i] = (i % 2 == 0) ? -elements[i + 1] : elements[i - 1];
205	
206	        int dim_idx = laneId * numElemsPerThread + i;
207	        int half_dim = dim_idx / 2;
208	        float freq = compute_freq_yarn(base, rotary_dim, half_dim, factor, low, high);
209	        float theta = pos_id * freq;
210	        __sincosf(theta, &sin_vals[i], &cos_vals[i]);
211	      }
212	
213	    } else {
214	      // Neox style
215	      // Before data exchange with in warp, we need to sync.
216	      __syncwarp();
217	      int const half_rotary_lanes = rotary_lanes / 2;
218	      unsigned int active_mask = (1u << rotary_lanes) - 1;
219	      // Limitation: The operation below requires half_rotary_lanes to be a power of 2.
220	      // because it relies on __shfl_xor_sync to exchange data within a warp.
221	      for (int i = 0; i < numElemsPerThread; i++) {
222	        elements2[i] = __shfl_xor_sync(active_mask, elements[i], half_rotary_lanes);
223	        if (laneId < half_rotary_lanes) {
224	          elements2[i] = -elements2[i];
225	        }
226	
227	        int dim_idx = laneId * numElemsPerThread + i;
228	        dim_idx = (dim_idx * 2) % rotary_dim;
229	        int half_dim = dim_idx / 2;
230	        float freq = compute_freq_yarn(base, rotary_dim, half_dim, factor, low, high);
231	        float theta = pos_id * freq;
232	        __sincosf(theta, &sin_vals[i], &cos_vals[i]);
233	      }
234	      // __shfl_xor_sync does not provide memfence. Need to sync again.
235	      __syncwarp();
236	    }
237	
238	    for (int i = 0; i < numElemsPerThread; i++) {
239	      elements[i] = (elements[i] * cos_vals[i] + elements2[i] * sin_vals[i]) * attention_factor;
240	    }
241	  }
242	
243	  // Store.
244	  {
245	    vec_T vec;
246	    for (int i = 0; i < vecSize; i++) {
247	      __nv_bfloat162 vals = __float22bfloat162_rn(make_float2(elements[2 * i], elements[2 * i + 1]));
248	      reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat162&>(*(reinterpret_cast<uint*>(&vec) + i)) = vals;
249	    }
250	    vec_T* outputPtr = reinterpret_cast<vec_T*>(&qkv[offsetThread]);
251	    *outputPtr = vec;
252	  }
253	}
254	// Borrowed from
255	// https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/8125d079a43e9a0ba463a4ed1b639cefd084cec9/include/flashinfer/pos_enc.cuh#L568
256	#define DISPATCH_INTERLEAVE(interleave, INTERLEAVE, ...) \
257	  if (interleave) {                                      \
258	    const bool INTERLEAVE = true;                        \
259	    __VA_ARGS__                                          \
260	  } else {                                               \
261	    const bool INTERLEAVE = false;                       \
262	    __VA_ARGS__                                          \
263	  }
264	void launchFusedQKNormRope(
265	    void* qkv,
266	    int const num_tokens,
267	    int const num_heads_q,
268	    int const num_heads_k,
269	    int const num_heads_v,
270	    int const head_dim,
271	    float const eps,
272	    void const* q_weight,
273	    void const* k_weight,
274	    float const base,
275	    bool const interleave,
276	    int const* position_ids,
277	    float factor,
278	    float low,
279	    float high,
280	    float attention_factor,
281	    int const rotary_dim,
282	    cudaStream_t stream) {
283	  constexpr int blockSize = 256;
284	  int const warpsPerBlock = blockSize / 32;
285	  int const totalQKHeads = num_heads_q + num_heads_k;
286	  int const totalWarps = num_tokens * totalQKHeads;
287	  int const gridSize = common::divUp(totalWarps, warpsPerBlock);
288	  dim3 gridDim(gridSize);
289	  dim3 blockDim(blockSize);
290	  // Head dimensions should be a multiple of 64
291	  // Add more cases as needed
292	  switch (head_dim) {
293	    case 64:
294	      DISPATCH_INTERLEAVE(interleave, INTERLEAVE, {
295	        fusedQKNormRopeKernel<64, INTERLEAVE><<<gridDim, blockDim, 0, stream>>>(
296	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(qkv),
297	            num_heads_q,
298	            num_heads_k,
299	            num_heads_v,
300	            eps,
301	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(q_weight),
302	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(k_weight),
303	            base,
304	            position_ids,
305	            num_tokens,
306	            factor,
307	            low,
308	            high,
309	            attention_factor,
310	            rotary_dim);
311	      });
312	      break;
313	    case 128:
314	      DISPATCH_INTERLEAVE(interleave, INTERLEAVE, {
315	        fusedQKNormRopeKernel<128, INTERLEAVE><<<gridDim, blockDim, 0, stream>>>(
316	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(qkv),
317	            num_heads_q,
318	            num_heads_k,
319	            num_heads_v,
320	            eps,
321	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(q_weight),
322	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(k_weight),
323	            base,
324	            position_ids,
325	            num_tokens,
326	            factor,
327	            low,
328	            high,
329	            attention_factor,
330	            rotary_dim);
331	      });
332	      break;
333	    case 256:
334	      DISPATCH_INTERLEAVE(interleave, INTERLEAVE, {
335	        fusedQKNormRopeKernel<256, INTERLEAVE><<<gridDim, blockDim, 0, stream>>>(
336	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(qkv),
337	            num_heads_q,
338	            num_heads_k,
339	            num_heads_v,
340	            eps,
341	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(q_weight),
342	            reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16 const*>(k_weight),
343	            base,
344	            position_ids,
345	            num_tokens,
346	            factor,
347	            low,
348	            high,
349	            attention_factor,
350	            rotary_dim);
351	      });
352	      break;
353	    default:
354	      TORCH_CHECK(false, "Unsupported head dimension for fusedQKNormRope: ", head_dim);
355	  }

359	// Function for fused QK Norm and RoPE
360	// This operator applies RMS normalization and RoPE to Q and K tensors in a single CUDA kernel.
361	// The OP performs operations in-place on the input qkv tensor.
362	void fused_qk_norm_rope(
363	    torch::Tensor& qkv,           // Combined QKV tensor [num_tokens, (num_heads_q+num_heads_k+num_heads_v)*head_dim]
364	    int64_t num_heads_q,          // Number of query heads
365	    int64_t num_heads_k,          // Number of key heads
366	    int64_t num_heads_v,          // Number of value heads
367	    int64_t head_dim,             // Dimension per head
368	    double eps,                   // Epsilon for RMS normalization
369	    torch::Tensor& q_weight,      // RMSNorm weights for query [head_dim]
370	    torch::Tensor& k_weight,      // RMSNorm weights for key [head_dim]
371	    double base,                  // Base for RoPE computation
372	    bool is_neox,                 // Whether RoPE is applied in Neox style
373	    torch::Tensor& position_ids,  // Position IDs for RoPE [num_tokens]
374	    // parameters for yarn
375	    double factor,  // factor in rope_scaling in config.json. When it is not 1.0, it means the model is using yarn.
376	    double low,     // threshold for high frequency
377	    double high,    // threshold for low frequency
378	    double attention_factor,  // attention_factor applied on cos and sin
379	    int64_t rotary_dim) {
380	  // Input validation
381	  TORCH_CHECK(qkv.dim() == 2, "QKV tensor must be 2D: [num_tokens, (num_heads_q+num_heads_k+num_heads_v)*head_dim]");
382	  TORCH_CHECK(position_ids.dim() == 1, "Position IDs must be 1D: [num_tokens]");
383	  TORCH_CHECK(q_weight.dim() == 1, "Query weights must be 1D: [head_dim]");
384	  TORCH_CHECK(k_weight.dim() == 1, "Key weights must be 1D: [head_dim]");
385	  TORCH_CHECK(q_weight.size(0) == head_dim, "Query weights size must match head dimension");
386	  TORCH_CHECK(k_weight.size(0) == head_dim, "Key weights size must match head dimension");
387	  TORCH_CHECK(rotary_dim % (head_dim / 32) == 0, "rotary_dim must be divisible by numElemsPerThread");
388	  if (is_neox) {
389	    int64_t half_rotary_lanes = rotary_dim / (head_dim / 32) / 2;
390	    TORCH_CHECK(
391	        half_rotary_lanes >= 1 && (half_rotary_lanes & (half_rotary_lanes - 1)) == 0,
392	        "half_rotary_lanes must be a power of 2 for neox style, got ",
393	        half_rotary_lanes);
394	  }
395	  CHECK_INPUT(qkv, torch::kBFloat16);
396	  CHECK_INPUT(position_ids, torch::kInt32);
397	  CHECK_INPUT(q_weight, torch::kBFloat16);
398	  CHECK_INPUT(k_weight, torch::kBFloat16);
399	
400	  int64_t num_tokens = qkv.size(0);
401	  TORCH_CHECK(position_ids.size(0) == num_tokens, "Number of tokens in position_ids must match QKV");
402	
403	  int64_t total_heads = num_heads_q + num_heads_k + num_heads_v;
404	  TORCH_CHECK(
405	      qkv.size(1) == total_heads * head_dim, "QKV tensor size must match total number of heads and head dimension");
406	
407	  auto stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream(qkv.get_device());
408	
409	  tensorrt_llm::kernels::launchFusedQKNormRope(
410	      reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(qkv.data_ptr()),
411	      static_cast<int>(num_tokens),
412	      static_cast<int>(num_heads_q),
413	      static_cast<int>(num_heads_k),
414	      static_cast<int>(num_heads_v),
415	      static_cast<int>(head_dim),
416	      static_cast<float>(eps),
417	      reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(q_weight.data_ptr()),
418	      reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(k_weight.data_ptr()),
419	      static_cast<float>(base),
420	      !is_neox,  // interleave
421	      reinterpret_cast<int const*>(position_ids.data_ptr()),
422	      static_cast<float>(factor),
423	      static_cast<float>(low),
424	      static_cast<float>(high),
425	      static_cast<float>(attention_factor),
426	      static_cast<int>(rotary_dim),
427	      stream);
428	}

# 调研报告：Fused QK-Norm + RoPE on sm_120

## 1. RTX 6000D 带宽（重要 baseline）

| 卡 | VRAM | 总线 | 速率 | 带宽 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RTX 6000D（你的卡，sm_120） | 84 GB GDDR7 | **448-bit** | 28 Gbps | **~1568 GB/s** |
| RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell | 96 GB GDDR7 | 512-bit | 28 Gbps | ~1792 GB/s |
| H100 SXM | 80 GB HBM3 | — | — | 3350 GB/s |

**Roofline 推算**：q+k = 2×(8192×32×128)×2B = 128 MB R + 128 MB W ≈ 256 MB。1568 GB/s 下 fused 单 kernel 下限 ≈ **163 µs**。所以你三个 kernel 共 796 µs 中，fused 后理论可压到 ~200 µs（含 RMSNorm 权重 + position_ids + sin/cos overhead）。**4× 提升上限**，符合你预期的 fused 收益。
注意：sm_120 没有 HBM 也没有 sm_100 的 TMEM/tcgen05；它走 GDDR7，对 vec4 load 友好但 SM 数（156）少于 GB200，访存策略更接近 Ada/Hopper 而非 sm_100。

## 2. 现有 fused QK-norm + RoPE 实现（punch list）

- **TRT-LLM `fusedQKNormRopeKernel.cu`**：原始来源。1 warp / (token, head) 的 data-parallel reduce，warp-only reduce（`__shfl_xor_sync` over 32 lanes），无 cross-warp/cross-block 同步。head_dim 必须 % 64 == 0；switch 中只 instantiate `head_dim ∈ {64, 128, 256}`。
- **sgl-kernel 副本**（你正要用的）：`sgl-kernel/csrc/moe/fused_qknorm_rope_kernel.cu`，**逐字搬运 TRT-LLM**，bf16 only（`CHECK_INPUT(qkv, torch::kBFloat16)`），int32 position_ids，**in-place on a single concatenated qkv 2D tensor `[num_tokens, (nh_q+nh_k+nh_v)*head_dim]`**。
- **vLLM `qk_norm_rope_fusion`**：torch.compile pass，仅在 rms_norm/quant_fp8 走 custom op 时启用；NVIDIA 测试在 sm90/sm100，sm_120 未列。Inductor 自动生成的 fused kernel 在 NV 上有时比 custom 还快。
- **FlashInfer**：`apply_rope` / `apply_rope_pos_ids_inplace` 与 `rmsnorm` 是分离的；目前**没有 qk_norm+rope 单 kernel**。社区 issue #1983 实测 3D persistent 方案在 head_dim≤256 比 2D 慢 6%，**Qwen3 (head_dim=128) 不适合 persistent**。
- **Megatron `fused_mla_yarn_rope_apply`**：MLA 专用，不适用 MHA。
- **Liger-Kernel**：Triton fused rope 与 Triton rms_norm 分别存在，不是 qk_norm+rope 单 kernel。
- **Modular Mojo `generic_fused_qk_rope_bshd_continuous_batch`**：BSHD layout，需要连续 batch 视图，移植代价高。

## 3. RMSNorm 在 D=128 为何 sgl 的 300 µs 偏慢

- sgl_kernel 的 `rmsnorm` 走 FlashInfer norm；FlashInfer 默认 1 block / row、shared-mem 写回，对 (262144, 128) 这种**极扁宽** shape，block 数过多（&gt;256k row）使 block startup / sm scheduling 占比高，且 D=128 单 block 算力利用 ≤ 25%。
- TRT-LLM/Liger 的做法是 **1 warp / row**（32 threads × 4 bf16 = 128 元素），256 thread/block = 8 rows/block，block 数降到 ~32k。这正是 fused kernel 的策略，自动消化掉这个 bottleneck。
- 你那 151 µs 的 "naive triton" 极可能正是 1-warp-per-row + autotune block size，触及 ~80% 带宽——这就是真正的下限基线，而不是 sgl 的 300 µs。
- **apex `FusedRMSNorm`** 用 layer-norm 同款 1-block-per-row + welford，对小 D 同样不优；社区有上游化 PR 但未合入 PyTorch core。
- **FlashInfer 在 sglang #2258 有 bf16 精度 regression 历史**，已修但要注意 weight 转 fp32 vs bf16-cast 的差异。

## 4. Bitwise 可复现性

- 一旦你切到 fused warp-reduce kernel，**reduce 顺序固定为 `__shfl_xor_sync` 蝶形**（mask=16,8,4,2,1），与原 sgl `rmsnorm` 的 block-reduce 顺序**不同**——bf16 输入下 sum-of-squares 的 fp32 累加 ULP 量级不同会放大到 **每 token 几百 ULP** 差异，下游 attention softmax 后会被指数放大。
- Thinking Machines "Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference"（2025 年权威帖）给出标准答案：要 batch-invariant，必须 **per-row 完整在一个 SM 内 reduce + 固定 thread 数 + 固定 vec width**。fused TRT-LLM kernel **天然满足**（1 warp/row），单测下 batch_size 无关；但与 baseline rmsnorm 不 bit-equal，需要把"参考实现"换成 fused 版本。
- 不要追求与 baseline bit-equal——追求 fused 自身 batch-invariant + 与 fp64 reference 误差 ≤ 2 ULP。Kahan/补偿求和在 bf16 输入、warp-only reduce 下 overhead &gt; 收益，TRT-LLM/vLLM 都不用。
- llama.cpp PR #16016 "deterministic inference mode" 确认 RMSNorm/Matmul/Attention 是三大 nondeterminism 来源。

## 5. 2025/2026 进展 &amp; sm_120 警告

- **sm_120 缺 cubin 的家族性问题**：TRT-LLM Issues #11799、#10241、#11386 表明 trtllm-gen FMHA/NVFP4 KV cache **未发 sm_120 cubin**；好消息是 `fusedQKNormRopeKernel` **不属于 trtllm-gen**，是手写普通 CUDA + warp shfl，在 sm_80+ 都能编。但你 build 目录显示 sgl-kernel **只编了 sm_90 + sm_100 两个 target**——`/opt/.../build-cu13/CMakeFiles/{common_ops_sm90_build, common_ops_sm100_build}`，**没有 sm_120**。即使源码 sm_120 兼容，运行时也会撞 "no kernel image is available" 类错误（参考 sglang #17911 RTX 3090 同款 bug）。**先确认你 import 的 `common_ops.abi3.so` 编译时 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` 包含 12.0**，否则 fused_qk_norm_rope 会在 sm_120 直接 launch 失败。
- **MHA (nh_q=nh_k=32) 兼容性**：kernel 不分 GQA/MHA，warp-per-(token,head) 与比例无关；MHA 反而比 GQA 更受益（K 头数多 → fused 后省的 rmsnorm K 越多）。无已知 MHA-specific bug。
- **NeoX + factor=1.0**：你这条路径走 `if constexpr (interleave=false)` + `compute_freq_yarn` 在 factor=1 时 short-circuit，无 yarn 干扰；rotary_dim 必须满足 `half_rotary_lanes` = `rotary_dim / 4 / 2` 是 2 的幂。**rotary_dim=128, head_dim=128 → half_rotary_lanes = 16, OK**。
- **B200/FP8 上的 QK-Norm+RoPE fusion** 是 2025 vLLM 重点（changelog 多次提到），但你是 sm_120 + bf16，不踩 FP8 路径。
- 没看到针对 sm_120 的 TMA/cluster 实现——sm_120 没 cluster API，TMA 在 sm_120 上能用但 head_dim=128 的 row 太小，TMA 收益微弱。

## 关键操作建议

1. **先验证 sm_120 编译**：`cuobjdump --list-elf` 你那份 `common_ops.abi3.so`，看是否有 `sm_120` 段；没有则 fused_qk_norm_rope 直接不可用，要重编 sgl-kernel `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="9.0;10.0;12.0"`。
2. **bench 时拿 1-warp-per-row triton rmsnorm（你的 151 µs 那版）做替换基线**，不要拿 sgl 300 µs 当 baseline——前者已经压到 4× 提升空间的 ~70%，fused 真实收益可能只有 1.5–2×，不是 4×。
3. **数值对照用 fp64 ref**，不要要求 bit-equal 现 baseline；用 max-abs-err &lt; 2e-3 (bf16 ULP) 验收。
4. **接口要 concat 成 `[T, (nq+nk+nv)*D]`**：你现在 q/k 是分开的 (8192,32,128)，调用前需要拼 qkv（或 qk-only：nv=0 也合法，但 K/V 共用 proj 的话仍要对齐 layout）。MiniCPM-SALA 是 nh_q=32 nh_kv=2，qkv 早就 concat（看 MoE 路径），直接对接即可。

## 参考路径

- 本地 kernel 源：`/opt/SGLang-MiniCPM-SALA/packages/sglang-minicpm/sgl-kernel/csrc/moe/fused_qknorm_rope_kernel.cu`

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Microbench sgl_kernel.fused_qk_norm_rope vs production baseline.\n\nProduction baseline (per GLA layer):\n    1. q_norm = sgl_rmsnorm(q.reshape(T*NH, D), q_w)\n    2. k_norm = sgl_rmsnorm(k.reshape(T*NH, D), k_w)\n    3. q_rot, k_rot = rotary_emb(positions, q_norm.reshape(T, NH*D), k_norm.reshape(T, NH*D))\n    4. v unchanged\n\nFused (one CUDA kernel, in-place):\n    sgl_kernel.fused_qk_norm_rope(qkv, ...)\n\nShape (MiniCPM-SALA GLA, prefill chunk):\n    T = 8192 tokens\n    NH = 32 (lightning_nh = lightning_nkv = 32)\n    D = 128\n    rotary_dim = 128 (full)\n    is_neox = True (default)\n    base = 10000, no yarn (factor=1.0)\n    qkv layout: [T, 3*NH*D] bf16 contiguous (qkv_proj output already in this layout)\n\nNumerical: compare both impls vs torch fp64 reference. Report max_diff in bf16 ULP units.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\n\n_cuda_ptxas = Path(\"/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas\")\nif \"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\" not in os.environ and _cuda_ptxas.exists():\n    os.environ[\"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\"] = str(_cuda_ptxas)\n\nREPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\nsys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / \"demo-sala\" / \"sglang\" / \"python\"))\n\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\nfrom sgl_kernel import rmsnorm as sgl_rmsnorm\nfrom sgl_kernel import fused_qk_norm_rope\n\nfrom sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope\n\n\nT = 8192\nNH = 32\nD = 128\nEPS = 1e-6\nBASE = 10000.0\nMAX_POS = 8192   # only need up to T positions for the bench\nROTARY_DIM = D\nIS_NEOX = True\n\n\ndef time_us(fn, warmup=20, iters=300):\n    for _ in range(warmup):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    for i in range(iters):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    n = len(times)\n    return {\n        \"p10\": times[n // 10],\n        \"median\": times[n // 2],\n        \"p90\": times[(9 * n) // 10],\n        \"mean\": sum(times[n//20:n-n//20]) / max(1, n - 2*(n//20)),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------- fp64 reference ----------\ndef rmsnorm_fp64(x_bf16, w_bf16, eps):\n    x = x_bf16.double()\n    rstd = (x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps).rsqrt()\n    return (x * rstd) * w_bf16.double()\n\n\ndef rope_fp64_neox(x_bf16, positions_int, base, head_dim):\n    \"\"\"Apply NeoX rope to (T, NH, D) bf16 in fp64. Returns bf16-cast result.\"\"\"\n    T_, NH_, D_ = x_bf16.shape\n    x = x_bf16.double()\n    half = D_ // 2\n    inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, half, device=x.device, dtype=torch.float64) / half))\n    pos = positions_int.double()\n    freqs = torch.einsum(\"t,d->td\", pos, inv_freq)\n    cos_ = freqs.cos()[:, None, :].expand(T_, NH_, half)\n    sin_ = freqs.sin()[:, None, :].expand(T_, NH_, half)\n    x1 = x[..., :half]\n    x2 = x[..., half:]\n    rot_x1 = x1 * cos_ - x2 * sin_\n    rot_x2 = x1 * sin_ + x2 * cos_\n    return torch.cat([rot_x1, rot_x2], dim=-1)\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(f\"# device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    print(f\"# T={T} NH={NH} D={D} rotary_dim={ROTARY_DIM} is_neox={IS_NEOX} base={BASE}\")\n    torch.manual_seed(0)\n\n    qkv0 = (torch.randn((T, 3 * NH * D), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.4).contiguous()\n    q_w = (torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3).contiguous()\n    k_w = (torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3).contiguous()\n    positions = torch.arange(T, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.int32)\n    positions64 = positions.long()\n\n    # Slice helpers: q at [:NH*D], k at [NH*D:2*NH*D], v at [2*NH*D:]\n    q_off = 0\n    k_off = NH * D\n    v_off = 2 * NH * D\n\n    # ---------- baseline path (production layout) ----------\n    rope = get_rope(D, rotary_dim=ROTARY_DIM, max_position=MAX_POS, base=int(BASE),\n                    is_neox_style=IS_NEOX, rope_scaling=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n    rope = rope.to(\"cuda\")\n\n    def baseline_path():\n        # input: qkv0 (read-only); produce q_rot, k_rot in bf16\n        qkv = qkv0  # don't clone — baseline is read-only and produces new tensors\n        q_in = qkv[:, q_off:k_off].reshape(T * NH, D)\n        k_in = qkv[:, k_off:v_off].reshape(T * NH, D)\n        q_n = sgl_rmsnorm(q_in.contiguous(), q_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH * D)\n        k_n = sgl_rmsnorm(k_in.contiguous(), k_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH * D)\n        q_r, k_r = rope(positions.long(), q_n, k_n)\n        return q_r.reshape(T, NH, D), k_r.reshape(T, NH, D)\n\n    # ---------- fused path ----------\n    def fused_path():\n        qkv = qkv0.clone()  # in-place; clone for fairness\n        fused_qk_norm_rope(\n            qkv, NH, NH, NH, D, EPS,\n            q_w, k_w, BASE, IS_NEOX, positions,\n            1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, ROTARY_DIM,\n        )\n        q_r = qkv[:, q_off:k_off].reshape(T, NH, D)\n        k_r = qkv[:, k_off:v_off].reshape(T, NH, D)\n        return q_r, k_r\n\n    # ---------- numerical check vs fp64 ----------\n    q_in = qkv0[:, q_off:k_off].reshape(T, NH, D)\n    k_in = qkv0[:, k_off:v_off].reshape(T, NH, D)\n    q_n_ref = rmsnorm_fp64(q_in.reshape(-1, D), q_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH, D)\n    k_n_ref = rmsnorm_fp64(k_in.reshape(-1, D), k_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH, D)\n    q_ref_fp64 = rope_fp64_neox(q_n_ref, positions64, BASE, D)  # fp64 tensor\n    k_ref_fp64 = rope_fp64_neox(k_n_ref, positions64, BASE, D)\n\n    q_b, k_b = baseline_path()\n    q_f, k_f = fused_path()\n\n    def stats(name, out_bf16, ref_fp64):\n        diff = (out_bf16.double() - ref_fp64).abs()\n        max_d = diff.max().item()\n        mean_d = diff.mean().item()\n        # bf16 ulp at scale of |ref|\n        ref_amax = ref_fp64.abs().max().item()\n        rel = max_d / max(1e-9, ref_amax)\n        # bf16 ULP at val=1.0 is 2^-7 = 0.0078125\n        ulp = max_d / 0.0078125\n        print(f\"  {name:<22s} max_abs={max_d:.4g}  mean_abs={mean_d:.4g}  max_rel={rel:.4g}  bf16_ULP={ulp:.2f}\")\n\n    print(\"\\n[numerical: vs fp64 reference]\")\n    stats(\"baseline q\",  q_b, q_ref_fp64)\n    stats(\"baseline k\",  k_b, k_ref_fp64)\n    stats(\"fused    q\",  q_f, q_ref_fp64)\n    stats(\"fused    k\",  k_f, k_ref_fp64)\n\n    print(\"\\n[numerical: fused vs baseline (both bf16 outputs)]\")\n    diff_q = (q_b.double() - q_f.double()).abs()\n    diff_k = (k_b.double() - k_f.double()).abs()\n    print(f\"  q  max_abs={diff_q.max().item():.4g}  mean_abs={diff_q.mean().item():.4g}  bf16_ULP={diff_q.max().item()/0.0078125:.2f}\")\n    print(f\"  k  max_abs={diff_k.max().item():.4g}  mean_abs={diff_k.mean().item():.4g}  bf16_ULP={diff_k.max().item()/0.0078125:.2f}\")\n\n    # ---------- timing ----------\n    print(\"\\n[timing]\")\n    print(f\"  {'kernel':<35s} {'p10':>8s} {'med':>8s} {'mean':>8s} {'p90':>8s}   (us)\")\n    t = time_us(baseline_path)\n    print(f\"  {'baseline (sgl x2 + rotary_emb)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n    base_p10 = t['p10']\n\n    t = time_us(fused_path)\n    print(f\"  {'fused_qk_norm_rope (incl clone)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n    fused_with_clone = t['p10']\n\n    # also bench fused without clone (the actual production cost — qkv is fresh from gemm)\n    qkv_fused_buf = qkv0.clone()\n    def fused_inplace_only():\n        # production has fresh qkv from qkv_proj — re-init from a backing buffer\n        qkv_fused_buf.copy_(qkv0)\n        fused_qk_norm_rope(\n            qkv_fused_buf, NH, NH, NH, D, EPS,\n            q_w, k_w, BASE, IS_NEOX, positions,\n            1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, ROTARY_DIM,\n        )\n\n    t = time_us(fused_inplace_only)\n    print(f\"  {'fused (incl copy from buf)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n\n    # pure kernel time — re-launch on a stable buffer (won't overwrite intermediate state much)\n    def fused_pure():\n        fused_qk_norm_rope(\n            qkv_fused_buf, NH, NH, NH, D, EPS,\n            q_w, k_w, BASE, IS_NEOX, positions,\n            1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, ROTARY_DIM,\n        )\n    t = time_us(fused_pure)\n    print(f\"  {'fused pure kernel (in-place x N)':<35s} {t['p10']:>8.1f} {t['median']:>8.1f} {t['mean']:>8.1f} {t['p90']:>8.1f}\")\n    fused_pure_p10 = t['p10']\n\n    # ---------- extrapolation ----------\n    print(f\"\\n[extrapolation per chunk = 24 GLA layers]\")\n    print(f\"  baseline       x24 = {base_p10 * 24 / 1000:.2f} ms / chunk\")\n    print(f\"  fused (clone)  x24 = {fused_with_clone * 24 / 1000:.2f} ms / chunk\")\n    print(f\"  fused (pure)   x24 = {fused_pure_p10 * 24 / 1000:.2f} ms / chunk\")\n    print(f\"  expected save  ≈ {(base_p10 - fused_pure_p10) * 24 / 1000:.2f} ms / chunk \"\n          f\"(fused has clone overhead in real path it doesn't pay since qkv is fresh)\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

  "new_string": "    # ---------- baseline path (production layout) ----------\n    # Build cos_sin_cache like sglang RotaryEmbedding does\n    half = ROTARY_DIM // 2\n    inv_freq = 1.0 / (BASE ** (torch.arange(0, half, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.float32) / half))\n    pos_cache = torch.arange(MAX_POS, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.float32)\n    freqs = torch.einsum(\"t,d->td\", pos_cache, inv_freq)\n    cos_sin_cache = torch.cat([freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()], dim=-1).to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()  # (max_pos, rotary_dim)\n\n    def baseline_path():\n        # input: qkv0 (read-only); produce q_rot, k_rot in bf16\n        qkv = qkv0  # read-only\n        q_in = qkv[:, q_off:k_off].reshape(T * NH, D)\n        k_in = qkv[:, k_off:v_off].reshape(T * NH, D)\n        q_n = sgl_rmsnorm(q_in.contiguous(), q_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH * D).contiguous()\n        k_n = sgl_rmsnorm(k_in.contiguous(), k_w, EPS).reshape(T, NH * D).contiguous()\n        # in-place rope (matches sglang forward_cuda)\n        apply_rope_with_cos_sin_cache_inplace(\n            positions=positions.long(),\n            query=q_n,\n            key=k_n,\n            head_size=D,\n            cos_sin_cache=cos_sin_cache,\n            is_neox=IS_NEOX,\n        )\n        return q_n.reshape(T, NH, D), k_n.reshape(T, NH, D)"

> AGENT

线上结果：fused qk_norm_rope = 7.1ms（替代 25.1ms 的 qk_norm+rope），但 gla_kernel 31→38ms（多 7ms）— 因为 fused 后 q/k/v 是 strided view，`reshape(-1, 32, 128)` 走 view 不 copy，`chunk_simple_gla` 内部走慢路径。

加 `.contiguous()` 强制 contig，预计 4.6ms 而 gla_kernel 回到 31ms。

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python/sglang/srt/models/minicpm.py",
  "old_string": "            _evt_end(e)\n            s, e = _evt_record(\"gla_qkv_split_ms\")\n            q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)\n            _evt_end(e)\n            used_fused_qknorm_rope = True",
  "new_string": "            _evt_end(e)\n            s, e = _evt_record(\"gla_qkv_split_ms\")\n            # split returns strided views (stride 12288). chunk_simple_gla and\n            # downstream reshape can produce strided (T,NH,D) which puts fla on\n            # a slower path; force contiguous now (3 x 32MB copies vs ~7ms gla\n            # slowdown observed without).\n            q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)\n            q = q.contiguous()\n            k = k.contiguous()\n            v = v.contiguous()\n            _evt_end(e)\n            used_fused_qknorm_rope = True"
}
```

## 三个核心结论

**1. attn_gla_ms 实测确实降 16ms / chunk × 15 = 240ms 预期** — 即 fused 在 GLA 段确实省 16ms/chunk。
**2. MLP 段在 fused run 中无关地涨了 16ms/chunk** — `mlp_gate_up_ms` 70→80（FP4 GEMM kernel time，与 GLA 无任何耦合）。这是 server 重启后 GPU 状态噪声（autotune cache 命中、SM clock、内存碎片）。MLP wall 与 GLA fused/baseline 在 PROFILE=1 同一 run 内是相互独立的，但跑到了不同的 mlp_gate_up tactic / 状态。
**3. 净 wall（PROFILE=0 ×5）只 −20ms**：因为 MLP 涨了部分抵消，加上 wall 测量本身有 ±50ms 噪声。

## kernel 附近的实际开销 — 哪些值得继续优化

| 开销 | ms/chunk | 性质 | 后续路径 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `gla_qkv_split` 3× contig | 8.74 | **fused 路径新增** | 写自定义 fused kernel 直接输出 `[3,T,NH,D]` contig layout，省 8.74ms；重写 .cu 重编 sgl_kernel — 大工程 |
| `gla_qkv_proj` FP4 GEMM | 45.7 | 已 cuDNN 优化 | 已枯竭 |
| `gla_kernel` chunk_simple_gla | 28.5 | fla GLA chunk | §3.15 已部分否决；可继续 BK/BV sweep（已建 bench_gla_chunk_h_bkv.py / o_bkv.py） |
| `gla_o_norm + z_proj + sigmoid_mul + o_proj` 后段 | 21.2 | elementwise 链 | 写 `sigmoid_mul + scaled_fp4_quant` fused kernel，~2.7ms 收益 |
| `gla_initial_state + temporal_write` | 1.6 | state I/O | 已小 |

## 我的建议

当前 fused 已是 GLA 主路径上"敲掉一个 25.1ms 桩"最大单点，但被 split contig copy 8.74ms 吃回 1/3。继续推进收益更大的两条：

**A. 自定义 fused kernel 输出 [3,T,NH,D] contig** — 省 8.74ms，净 ~10ms wall 提升（最大收益但要改 sgl-kernel CUDA）
**B. `sigmoid_mul + scaled_fp4_quant` fused** — 省 2-3ms（中等工程量，可 triton 写）
**C. 现状保留** — 已稳定省 16ms/chunk attn_gla wall，bitwise 比 baseline 更接近 fp64 真值

你想走 A、B、C 哪条？

Commit 完成。现在写自定义 fused kernel — 用 triton 快速迭代（避免重编 sgl-kernel .so），数值跑通后视情况硬编 CUDA。

**设计**：
- Input: qkv `(T, 3*NH*D)` bf16 read-only
- Output: q_out / k_out / v_out 三个独立 `(T, NH, D)` bf16 contig
- Q/K：rmsnorm + NeoX rope；V：直接 copy
- 1 program / (token, head) — warp-per-row 风格

  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Triton fused qk_norm + rope kernel that writes Q/K/V to SEPARATE contig\noutput buffers, eliminating the post-split contiguous() copies (~8.74 ms /\nchunk in production) that the in-place TRT-LLM kernel forces.\n\nLayout:\n  qkv: (T, total_heads * D) bf16 contig, total_heads = nh_q + nh_k + nh_v\n  q_out: (T, nh_q, D) bf16 contig\n  k_out: (T, nh_k, D) bf16 contig\n  v_out: (T, nh_v, D) bf16 contig\n  q_weight, k_weight: (D,) bf16\n  position_ids: (T,) int32\n  cos_sin_cache: (max_pos, D) fp32 — packed [cos | sin] like sgl_kernel\n                  apply_rope_with_cos_sin_cache_inplace expects\n\nPer-(token, head) program:\n  - load D bf16 elements from qkv (128 per program; 4 warps × 32 lanes × 1)\n  - if Q: rmsnorm with q_weight; rope; store to q_out\n  - if K: rmsnorm with k_weight; rope; store to k_out\n  - if V: store as-is to v_out\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport torch\n\n_cuda_ptxas = Path(\"/usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas\")\nif \"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\" not in os.environ and _cuda_ptxas.exists():\n    os.environ[\"TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH\"] = str(_cuda_ptxas)\n\nimport triton\nimport triton.language as tl\nfrom sgl_kernel import rmsnorm as sgl_rmsnorm\nfrom sgl_kernel import fused_qk_norm_rope, apply_rope_with_cos_sin_cache_inplace\n\nT = 8192\nNH = 32  # nh_q == nh_k == nh_v in MiniCPM-SALA GLA\nD = 128\nEPS = 1e-6\nBASE = 10000.0\n\n\n@triton.jit\ndef _fused_qknorm_rope_oop_kernel(\n    QKV,        # (T, total_heads*D) bf16, contig\n    Q_OUT,      # (T, NH_Q, D) bf16, contig\n    K_OUT,      # (T, NH_K, D) bf16, contig\n    V_OUT,      # (T, NH_V, D) bf16, contig\n    Q_W,        # (D,) bf16\n    K_W,        # (D,) bf16\n    COS_SIN,    # (max_pos, D) fp32 — [cos[:half] | sin[:half]] flat\n    POSITIONS,  # (T,) int32\n    T_,\n    NH_Q: tl.constexpr,\n    NH_K: tl.constexpr,\n    NH_V: tl.constexpr,\n    D_: tl.constexpr,\n    HALF: tl.constexpr,\n    EPS_: tl.constexpr,\n):\n    \"\"\"Grid: (T_, NH_Q + NH_K + NH_V).\"\"\"\n    tok_idx = tl.program_id(0)\n    head_lin = tl.program_id(1)\n    total_heads: tl.constexpr = NH_Q + NH_K + NH_V\n\n    is_q = head_lin < NH_Q\n    is_k = (head_lin >= NH_Q) & (head_lin < NH_Q + NH_K)\n    # else V\n\n    cols = tl.arange(0, D_)\n\n    # Compute input offset within qkv [tok, head_lin*D + cols]\n    in_offset = tok_idx * total_heads * D_ + head_lin * D_ + cols\n    x = tl.load(QKV + in_offset).to(tl.float32)\n\n    if is_q | is_k:\n        # rmsnorm\n        var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / D_\n        rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + EPS_)\n        # weight\n        if is_q:\n            w = tl.load(Q_W + cols).to(tl.float32)\n        else:\n            w = tl.load(K_W + cols).to(tl.float32)\n        x = (x * rstd) * w\n\n        # NeoX rope: rotate first half with second half\n        # cos_sin layout: [cos(0..HALF-1) | sin(0..HALF-1)]\n        pos = tl.load(POSITIONS + tok_idx).to(tl.int32)\n        half_cols = tl.arange(0, HALF)\n        cos = tl.load(COS_SIN + pos * D_ + half_cols)        # (HALF,) fp32\n        sin = tl.load(COS_SIN + pos * D_ + HALF + half_cols)  # (HALF,) fp32\n\n        # Build x1 (first half) and x2 (second half) by gather\n        # Layout: x = concat(x1, x2). x1[i] is at index i; x2[i] at HALF+i.\n        # NeoX rotation:\n        #   y1 = x1 * cos - x2 * sin\n        #   y2 = x1 * sin + x2 * cos\n        x1 = tl.load(QKV + tok_idx * total_heads * D_ + head_lin * D_ + half_cols).to(tl.float32)\n        # Re-apply norm on x1 / x2 (since we re-loaded — but we already normed x).\n        # Simpler: index into x by mask.\n        # Use the already-normed x:\n        # x is (D,). For NeoX: y1 = x[:HALF]*cos - x[HALF:]*sin, y2 = x[:HALF]*sin + x[HALF:]*cos\n        # Triton lacks slicing, so use mask + roll trick.\n        is_first = cols < HALF\n        # paired index: if i<HALF, pair at i+HALF; else pair at i-HALF\n        # delta sign for the rotation:\n        #   y[i] = (i<HALF) ? (x[i]*cos[i]   - x[i+HALF]*sin[i])\n        #                   : (x[i-HALF]*sin[i-HALF] + x[i]*cos[i-HALF])\n        # Build cos_full / sin_full (D,) where for i<HALF idx=i, else idx=i-HALF.\n        idx_in_half = tl.where(is_first, cols, cols - HALF)\n        cos_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + pos * D_ + idx_in_half)  # (D,) fp32\n        sin_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + pos * D_ + HALF + idx_in_half)\n        # paired x: if i<HALF use x[i+HALF]; else use x[i-HALF]\n        pair_idx = tl.where(is_first, cols + HALF, cols - HALF)\n        # We need to gather from 'x' the value at pair_idx. Triton can do this only\n        # if we restructure: x is a 1D tile of len D. tl.load with arange already\n        # gives that. To gather pair, do a second load from QKV at the pair offset\n        # WITH the same norm applied. Easiest is to compute x_pair separately.\n        x_raw_pair = tl.load(QKV + tok_idx * total_heads * D_ + head_lin * D_ + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n        # Apply same rstd and weight at pair_idx\n        if is_q:\n            w_pair = tl.load(Q_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n        else:\n            w_pair = tl.load(K_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n        x_pair = (x_raw_pair * rstd) * w_pair\n\n        # NeoX: y[i] = x[i]*cos_full[i] + sgn * x_pair[i]*sin_full[i]\n        # where sgn = -1 if i<HALF else +1\n        sgn = tl.where(is_first, -1.0, 1.0)\n        y = x * cos_full + sgn * x_pair * sin_full\n\n        # Write to q_out / k_out (always contig (T, NH, D))\n        if is_q:\n            head_idx = head_lin\n            out_offset = tok_idx * NH_Q * D_ + head_idx * D_ + cols\n            tl.store(Q_OUT + out_offset, y.to(Q_OUT.dtype.element_ty))\n        else:\n            head_idx = head_lin - NH_Q\n            out_offset = tok_idx * NH_K * D_ + head_idx * D_ + cols\n            tl.store(K_OUT + out_offset, y.to(K_OUT.dtype.element_ty))\n    else:\n        # V: just copy\n        head_idx = head_lin - NH_Q - NH_K\n        out_offset = tok_idx * NH_V * D_ + head_idx * D_ + cols\n        tl.store(V_OUT + out_offset, x.to(V_OUT.dtype.element_ty))\n\n\ndef fused_qknorm_rope_oop_triton(qkv, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions,\n                                  nh_q, nh_k, nh_v, head_dim, eps):\n    T_ = qkv.shape[0]\n    q_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_q, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    k_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_k, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    v_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_v, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    grid = (T_, nh_q + nh_k + nh_v)\n    _fused_qknorm_rope_oop_kernel[grid](\n        qkv, q_out, k_out, v_out, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions, T_,\n        NH_Q=nh_q, NH_K=nh_k, NH_V=nh_v, D_=head_dim, HALF=head_dim // 2,\n        EPS_=eps,\n        num_warps=4, num_stages=2,\n    )\n    return q_out, k_out, v_out\n\n\ndef time_us(fn, warmup=20, iters=300):\n    for _ in range(warmup):\n        fn()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]\n    for i in range(iters):\n        starts[i].record()\n        fn()\n        ends[i].record()\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\n    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))\n    n = len(times)\n    return {\"p10\": times[n//10], \"median\": times[n//2], \"p90\": times[(9*n)//10]}\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(f\"# device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    print(f\"# T={T} NH={NH} D={D}\")\n    torch.manual_seed(0)\n\n    qkv0 = (torch.randn((T, 3 * NH * D), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.4).contiguous()\n    q_w = (torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3).contiguous()\n    k_w = (torch.randn((D,), device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.3).contiguous()\n    positions = torch.arange(T, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.int32)\n\n    half = D // 2\n    inv_freq = 1.0 / (BASE ** (torch.arange(0, half, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.float32) / half))\n    pos_cache = torch.arange(T, device=\"cuda\", dtype=torch.float32)\n    freqs = torch.einsum(\"t,d->td\", pos_cache, inv_freq)\n    cos_sin_cache = torch.cat([freqs.cos(), freqs.sin()], dim=-1).contiguous()  # fp32\n\n    # === Reference path: existing sgl_kernel.fused_qk_norm_rope (in-place + split + contig) ===\n    )\n        q, k, v = qkv.split([NH * D, NH * D, NH * D], dim=-1)\n        q = q.contiguous().reshape(T, NH, D)\n        k = k.contiguous().reshape(T, NH, D)\n        v = v.contiguous().reshape(T, Grid: (cdiv(T, BLOCK_M), total_heads).\"\"\"\n    block_idx = tl.program_id(0)\n    head_lin = tl.program_id(1)\n    total_heads: tl.constexpr = NH_Q + NH_K + NH_V\n\n    is_q = head_lin < NH_Q\n    is_k = (head_lin >= NH_Q) & (head_lin < NH_Q + NH_K)\n\n    rows = block_idx * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)\n    rmask = rows < T_\n    cols = tl.arange(0, D_)\n    # offsets[i, j] = rows[i] * total_heads*D + head_lin*D + cols[j]\n    in_offsets = rows[:, None] * (total_heads * D_) + head_lin * D_ + cols[None, :]\n    x = tl.load(QKV + in_offsets, mask=rmask[:, None], other=0.0).to(tl.float32)  # (BLOCK_M, D)\n\n    if is_q | is_k:\n        var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=1) / D_  # (BLOCK_M,)\n        rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + EPS_)  # (BLOCK_M,)\n        if is_q:\n            w = tl.load(Q_W + cols).to(tl.float32)\n        else:\n            w = tl.load(K_W + cols).to(tl.float32)\n        xn = x * rstd[:, None] * w[None, :]  # (BLOCK_M, D)\n\n        # rope per-row positions\n        pos = tl.load(POSITIONS + rows, mask=rmask, other=0).to(tl.int32)  # (BLOCK_M,)\n        is_first = cols < HALF  # (D,)\n        idx_in_half = tl.where(is_first, cols, cols - HALF)  # (D,)\n        # cos/sin lookup: shape (BLOCK_M, D) — pos[i] varies\n        cos_offs = pos[:, None] * D_ + idx_in_half[None, :]\n        sin_offs = pos[:, None] * D_ + HALF + idx_in_half[None, :]\n        cos_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + cos_offs)  # fp32 (BLOCK_M, D)\n        sin_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + sin_offs)\n\n        pair_idx = tl.where(is_first, cols + HALF, cols - HALF)  # (D,)\n        pair_offs = rows[:, None] * (total_heads * D_) + head_lin * D_ + pair_idx[None, :]\n        x_pair_raw = tl.load(QKV + pair_offs, mask=rmask[:, None], other=0.0).to(tl.float32)\n        if is_q:\n            w_pair = tl.load(Q_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n        else:\n            w_pair = tl.load(K_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n        x_pair = x_pair_raw * rstd[:, None] * w_pair[None, :]\n        sgn = tl.where(is_first, -1.0, 1.0)  # (D,)\n        y = xn * cos_full + sgn[None, :] * x_pair * sin_full  # (BLOCK_M, D)\n\n        if is_q:\n            out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_Q * D_) + head_lin * D_ + cols[None, :]\n            tl.store(Q_OUT + out_offsets, y.to(Q_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n        else:\n            head_in_k = head_lin - NH_Q\n            out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_K * D_) + head_in_k * D_ + cols[None, :]\n            tl.store(K_OUT + out_offsets, y.to(K_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n    else:\n        head_in_v = head_lin - NH_Q - NH_K\n        out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_V * D_) + head_in_v * D_ + cols[None, :]\n        tl.store(V_OUT + out_offsets, x.to(V_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n\n\ndef fused_qknorm_rope_oop_triton(qkv, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions,\n                                  nh_q, nh_k, nh_v, head_dim, eps,\n                                  variant=\"v2\", block_m=4, num_warps=4, num_stages=2):\n    T_ = qkv.shape[0]\n    q_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_q, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    k_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_k, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    v_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_v, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n    if variant == \"v1\":\n        grid = (T_, nh_q + nh_k + nh_v)\n        _qknorm_rope_oop_v1[grid](\n            qkv, q_out, k_out, v_out, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions, T_,\n            NH_Q=nh_q, NH_K=nh_k, NH_V=nh_v, D_=head_dim, HALF=head_dim // 2,\n            EPS_=eps, num_warps=num_warps, num_stages=num_stages,\n        )\n    else:  # v2 tile\n        grid = (triton.cdiv(T_, block_m), nh_q + nh_k + nh_v)\n        _qknorm_rope_oop_v2_tile[grid](\n            qkv, q_out, k_out, v_out, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions, T_,\n            NH_Q=nh_q, NH_K=nh_k, NH_V=nh_v, D_=head_dim, HALF=head_dim // 2,\n            EPS_=eps, BLOCK_M=block_m, num_warps=num_warps, num_stages=num_stages,\n        )\n    return q_out, k_out, v_out"

HALF)\n            cos_offs = pos[:, None] * D_ + idx_in_half[None, :]\n            sin_offs = pos[:, None] * D_ + HALF + idx_in_half[None, :]\n            cos_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + cos_offs)\n            sin_full = tl.load(COS_SIN + sin_offs)\n\n            pair_idx = tl.where(is_first, cols + HALF, cols - HALF)\n            pair_offs = rows[:, None] * (total_heads * D_) + head_lin * D_ + pair_idx[None, :]\n            x_pair_raw = tl.load(QKV + pair_offs, mask=rmask[:, None], other=0.0).to(tl.float32)\n            if is_q:\n                w_pair = tl.load(Q_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n            else:\n                w_pair = tl.load(K_W + pair_idx).to(tl.float32)\n            x_pair = x_pair_raw * rstd[:, None] * w_pair[None, :]\n            sgn = tl.where(is_first, -1.0, 1.0)\n            y = xn * cos_full + sgn[None, :] * x_pair * sin_full\n\n            if is_q:\n                out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_Q * D_) + head_lin * D_ + cols[None, :]\n                tl.store(Q_OUT + out_offsets, y.to(Q_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n            else:\n                head_in_k = head_lin - NH_Q\n                out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_K * D_) + head_in_k * D_ + cols[None, :]\n                tl.store(K_OUT + out_offsets, y.to(K_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n        else:\n            head_in_v = head_lin - NH_Q - NH_K\n            out_offsets = rows[:, None] * (NH_V * D_) + head_in_v * D_ + cols[None, :]\n            tl.store(V_OUT + out_offsets, x.to(V_OUT.dtype.element_ty), mask=rmask[:, None])\n\n\n    def _minicpm_fused_qknorm_rope_oop(\n        qkv: torch.Tensor,\n        q_w: torch.Tensor,\n        k_w: torch.Tensor,\n        cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,\n        positions: torch.Tensor,\n        nh_q: int, nh_k: int, nh_v: int, head_dim: int, eps: float,\n        block_m: int = 16, num_warps: int = 2, num_stages: int = 2,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Returns three contig tensors: q (T,nh_q,D), k (T,nh_k,D), v (T,nh_v,D).\"\"\"\n        T_ = qkv.shape[0]\n        q_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_q, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n        k_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_k, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n        v_out = torch.empty((T_, nh_v, head_dim), device=qkv.device, dtype=qkv.dtype)\n        if positions.dtype != torch.int32:\n            positions = positions.to(torch.int32)\n        grid = (triton.cdiv(T_, block_m), nh_q + nh_k + nh_v)\n        _gla_qknorm_rope_oop_kernel[grid](\n            qkv, q_out, k_out, v_out, q_w, k_w, cos_sin_cache, positions, T_,\n            NH_Q=nh_q, NH_K=nh_k, NH_V=nh_v,\n            D_=head_dim, HALF=head_dim // 2,\n            EPS_=eps,\n            BLOCK_M=block_m, num_warps=num_warps, num_stages=num_stages,\n        )\n        return q_out, k_out, v_out\nelse:\n    _minicpm_fused_qknorm_rope_oop = None"

34	BS = BT  # split_size==chunk_size in production

36	
37	def build_inputs(seed: int = 0):
38	    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
39	    k = torch.randn((B, T, H, K), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen)
40	    v = torch.randn((B, T, H, V), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, generator=gen)
41	    g_gamma = torch.randn((H,), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32, generator=gen) * (-0.1)
42	    return k, v, g_gamma
43	
44	
45	def alloc_h(BK, BV):
46	    NS = triton.cdiv(T, BS)
47	    h = torch.empty((B, NS, H, K, V), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
48	    ht = torch.empty((B, H, K, V), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
49	    return h, ht
50	
51	
52	def launch(k, v, g_gamma, BK, BV, num_warps, num_stages):
53	    h, ht = alloc_h(BK, BV)
54	    grid = (triton.cdiv(K, BK), triton.cdiv(V, BV), B * H)
55	    raw_kernel[grid](
56	        k=k, v=v, h=h, g=None, g_gamma=g_gamma, gk=None, gv=None,
57	        h0=None, ht=ht, cu_seqlens=None, split_offsets=None,
58	        T=T, H=H, K=K, V=V, BT=BT, BS=BS, BK=BK, BV=BV,
59	        USE_G=False, USE_G_GAMMA=True, USE_GK=False, USE_GV=False,
60	        USE_INITIAL_STATE=False, STORE_FINAL_STATE=True, IS_VARLEN=False,
61	        num_warps=num_warps, num_stages=num_stages,
62	    )
63	    return h, ht
64	
65	
66	def time_us(fn, warmup=10, iters=50):
67	    for _ in range(warmup):
68	        fn()
69	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
70	    starts = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]
71	    ends = [torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) for _ in range(iters)]
72	    for i in range(iters):
73	        starts[i].record()
74	        fn()
75	        ends[i].record()
76	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
77	    times = sorted(s.elapsed_time(e) * 1000.0 for s, e in zip(starts, ends))
78	    return times[len(times) // 2]
79	
80	
81	def main():
82	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
83	    k, v, g_gamma = build_inputs()
84	
85	    # Reference: BK=64, BV=64, w=4, s=3 — typical default for sm_120.
86	    h_ref, ht_ref = launch(k, v, g_gamma, 64, 64, 4, 3)
87	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
88	
89	    sm_count = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count
90	    print(f"# device sm_count={sm_count}")
91	    print(f"# shape B={B} T={T} H={H} K={K} V={V} BT={BT}")
92	    print(f"# baseline grid=({K//64},{V//64},{B*H})={K//64*V//64*B*H} blocks (BK=64,BV=64)")
93	    print()
94	    print(f"{'BK':>4} {'BV':>4} {'w':>2} {'s':>2} {'grid':>8} {'us_med':>10} {'h_diff':>10} {'ht_diff':>10} {'status':>8}")
95	
96	    candidates = []
97	    for BK in [32, 64, 128]:
98	        for BV in [32, 64, 128]:
99	            for nw in [2, 4, 8]:
100	                for ns in [2, 3, 4]:
101	                    candidates.append((BK, BV, nw, ns))
102	
103	    rows = []
104	    for BK, BV, nw, ns in candidates:
105	        try:
106	            h, ht = launch(k, v, g_gamma, BK, BV, nw, ns)
107	            us = time_us(lambda: launch(k, v, g_gamma, BK, BV, nw, ns), warmup=5, iters=20)
108	            h_diff = (h.float() - h_ref.float()).abs().max().item()
109	            ht_diff = (ht - ht_ref).abs().max().item()
110	            grid_n = (K // BK) * (V // BV) * B * H
111	            status = "ok"
112	        except Exception as e:
113	            us = float("nan")
114	            h_diff = ht_diff = float("nan")
115	            grid_n = 0
116	            status = f"FAIL:{type(e).__name__}"
117	        rows.append((BK, BV, nw, ns, grid_n, us, h_diff, ht_diff, status))
118	        print(f"{BK:>4} {BV:>4} {nw:>2} {ns:>2} {grid_n:>8} {us:>10.1f} {h_diff:>10.4g} {ht_diff:>10.4g} {status:>8}")
119	
120	    rows_ok = [r for r in rows if r[-1] == "ok"]
121	    rows_ok.sort(key=lambda r: r[5])
122	    print("\n# top 10 by us_med:")

125	        print(f"# BK={BK} BV={BV} w={nw} s={ns} grid={grid_n} us={us:.1f} h_diff={hd:.4g} ht_diff={htd:.4g}")
126	
127	    # Reference timing
128	    us_ref = time_us(lambda: launch(k, v, g_gamma, 64, 64, 4, 3), warmup=5, iters=20)
129	    print(f"\n# baseline BK=64 BV=64 w=4 s=3: {us_ref:.1f} us")
